project_info.theme: Voucher-tier poster for a sports-nutrition ecommerce campaign
project_info.color_palette: Pale Yellow, Bright Yellow, Black, White, Charcoal

main_subject.detail: A centered black hero voucher above four yellow coupon tiles in a two-by-two grid, framed by a white rounded panel on a pale-yellow background.
main_subject.style: Graphic ecommerce voucher design, bold sans-serif typography, clean high-legibility hierarchy

items: Top Left: A small dumbbell prop overlapping the white panel.
Top Center: Large black voucher with a coin icon and the hero discount offer.
Middle/Lower: Four yellow coupon tickets in a two-by-two grid, each with a currency icon and one tier.
Bottom: Large black urgency or CTA line.
Background: Pale yellow field with a white rounded-rectangle content panel.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Sharp black-yellow contrast, clean white framing, minimal soft shadow below tickets

technical_specs.render_style: Vector-inspired ecommerce sale poster with crisp 3D accessory prop

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: Create a square Ultimate Sup voucher-tier poster. Preserve a pale-yellow background, large white rounded panel, one oversized black hero voucher at the top, four yellow coupon tickets in a two-by-two grid, and a bold footer {{FOOTER_CTA}}. Use {{HERO_DISCOUNT}} and {{HERO_THRESHOLD}} on the hero voucher; use the four approved tier value/threshold pairs on the smaller tickets. Include a small REF_DUMBBELL_PROP and optional REF_BRAND_LOGO. Keep text hierarchy simple, crisp, and readable.
prompt.negative_prompt: incorrect currency, more or fewer than four tier tickets, unreadable amounts, wrong logo, cluttered products, low contrast, warped ticket edges, watermark

assets.name: Voucher grid composition
assets.usage: Preserve hero-voucher plus four-tier grid structure.

assets.name: Approved Ultimate Sup logo
assets.usage: Place only where the current campaign requires branding.

assets.name: Dumbbell visual
assets.source: Attach approved prop or recreate a neutral dumbbell
assets.usage: Keep as a small upper-left sports cue; do not compete with voucher values.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Use REF_LAYOUT for geometry. Render ticket shapes and props as graphics; compose exact voucher values, thresholds, and fine text in post-production.

substitutable_fields.replacement_rule: Use approved voucher percentage/value and SGD threshold.
Keep four tiers unless the ticket explicitly changes the grid.
Use current urgency message or CTA.
